briefdescription.para: The thread in which we relay data to the replica.
Recovery instance to read xlog from the disk.
A filter of replica ids whose rows should be ignored.

detaileddescription.para: Each set filter bit corresponds to a replica id whose rows shouldn't be relayed. The list of ids to ignore is passed by the replica on subscribe.

briefdescription.para: Local vclock at the moment of subscribe, used to check dataset on the other side and send missing data rows if any.
List of garbage collection messages awaiting confirmation from the replica.
Time when last row was sent to peer.
True if the relay needs Raft updates.

detaileddescription.para: It can live fine without sending Raft updates, if it is a relay to an anonymous replica, for example.
